name: XPeng Inc.
sector: Consumer Discretionary / Auto Manufacturing — electric vehicles (China)
moat_justification: Real smart-driving technology differentiation (in-house ADAS/VLA and Turing chip, validated by the Volkswagen partnership) and a large self-operated charging network, but no durable pricing power in a price-war market: vehicle margin was only 12.8% in FY2025, gross margin recovery to 18.9% leans on Volkswagen services revenue, and the ROIC proxy was negative in all of the last 5 fiscal years (-15.8%, -22.9%, -33.0%, -21.2%, -8.5%). A moat of 7+ cannot sit on that ROIC history, so 3/10 (weak).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 3.6%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency CNY converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x2.0 ordinary shares per ADS (XPeng Inc. Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-04-16): the ADSs, each representing two Class A ordinary shares, are listed on NYSE under XPEV; the same ratio is stated in the company's quarterly earnings releases (each ADS represents two Class A ordinary shares, with per-ADS EPS stated at twice per-ordinary-share EPS)) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
one_liner: China smart-EV maker at a volume inflection, moat 3/10 — does not clear 15%: Tier F, because normalized (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings are negative (-$0.29 per ADS; latest FY2025 alone +$0.65 per ADS) after five years of negative ROIC, and H1 2026 interim results returned to net losses; no hurdle-clearing price is computable on a negative OE base.
moat_for: In-house ADAS stack (XNGP / VLA) and Turing AI chip — among the leaders in China smart-driving, validated by Volkswagen's technology partnership and R&D-services revenue
Self-operated ultra-fast charging network (3,159 stations at FY2025 per the annual report) supports the brand and ownership experience
Broadened model range (MONA M03, P7+, G7, X9 EREV) drove deliveries +125.9% in FY2025 and overseas expansion is scaling
Technology licensing / services revenue is high-margin and diversifies away from pure vehicle gross profit
moat_against: No pricing power in China's EV price war: vehicle margin only 12.8% in FY2025 despite scale, and buyers switch brands with near-zero cost
ROIC proxy negative in all of the last 5 fiscal years (-33.0% in FY2023 to -8.5% in FY2025, fundamentals.json) — the franchise has never earned above its cost of capital
Scale disadvantage vs BYD and Tesla China in procurement, manufacturing and charging economics
Gross margin is flattered by non-vehicle services (Volkswagen technical R&D services); core vehicle economics remain thin
China consumer / regulatory and VIE/ADS tail risks, plus heavy ongoing AI/robotics R&D spend that must be funded from the car business
